summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SiteHisab MVP. Backend: all 34 pytest tests pass (100%) covering auth, owner/supervisor RBAC, sites, labourers, attendance (upsert + daily_reports), bills (balance/GST), advances, payroll aggregation, dashboard, summary and supervisor isolation (403 on /dashboard, /auth/supervisors, unassigned site access). Frontend (mobile-first Expo web, 390x844): verified owner registration->login flow, dashboard totals + site cards + add-site, site workspace all 6 quick-action tiles, labourers add, attendance mark + Save & Upload (shows 'Uploaded' + '1 present ₹600'), billing add with GST toggle (Non-GST tag + balance ₹7,000 computed), advances add, payroll row shows Mazdoori ₹600 - Advance ₹500 = Net ₹100, daily reports list populated after attendance save, Team tab create supervisor with site assignment, logout, supervisor login shows only Sites+Account tabs (no Team) and only assigned site. No React Native red-screen errors. No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' - non-blocking but will break in future RN-Web versions.

action_items: (Low) Replace deprecated RN-Web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents in shared UI components (likely Card/Sheet/Button in /app/frontend/src/components/ui).

(Note) Backend pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope but tests share state via module-scoped fixture. Running with that default causes cross-worker KeyErrors. Current suite must be run with `-n 0`. Either (a) restructure fixtures to be worker-independent, or (b) relax addopts. Documented inside the test file.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers; prefer lifespan context.
No pagination on list endpoints (bills, labourers, advances) - fine for MVP, consider for scale.
oid() raises 400 for malformed site_id in get_accessible_site before 404 - acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows verified (owner reg/login, dashboard, site CRUD, labourers, attendance+report, billing+GST, advances, payroll, team supervisor create, logout, supervisor login/isolation)

seed_data_creation: Tests create and self-clean TEST_* prefixed sites/labourers/bills/advances/supervisors. One leftover TEST_UI_Site_* site remains from the frontend run (not auto-deleted) along with its labourer, bill, advance, attendance record and a TEST_UI_Sup supervisor. Safe to leave or clean manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests MUST be run with `pytest backend/tests/test_sitehisab_api.py -n 0` to override the project's parallel xdist default (module-scoped workflow_state fixture). Owner creds: 9000000001/test1234. Frontend quick-action tiles for 'billing' and 'reports' are below the fold on 390x667+ viewports; always scroll_into_view_if_needed before clicking them.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no blocking issues found. Minor: frontend test needed scroll_into_view for action-billing/action-reports tiles (not a product bug).
